tools.name: check_au_domain
tools.description: Use this whenever the user asks about the age, registration date, first-seen date, operator, owner, ABN, legitimacy, safety, trustworthiness or scam risk of any Australian (.au) website, domain, link, online shop, invoice sender or text message — covering .com.au, .net.au, .org.au, .au, .asn.au and

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_au_domain · Private data: check_au_domain · Public sink: check_au_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_au_domain · Private data: check_au_domain · Public sink: check_au_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
